claims.head: The Mammoth will send Weegar and Sergachev at Crosby
claims.call: The Mammoth’s P1 (Weegar and Sergachev) spends at least 45% of its 5-on-5 time against the Penguins’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Mammoth keep sending Weegar and Sergachev out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. André Tourigny has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Penguins’ first line is Crosby, Rust and Rakell.

claims.head: Forecheck against patience
claims.body: On forecheck pressure, Utah is one of the league’s best, but Pittsburgh is the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect the Mammoth to win more pucks back deep in the Penguins’ end.

notes.text: Trevor van Riemsdyk is day to day (lower body injury) and has missed the last 4 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Spencer Stastney has taken his spot beside Kris Letang.
Egor Chinakhov is day to day (lower body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-six forward. Ville Koivunen has taken his spot beside Evgeni Malkin and Tommy Novak.
Spencer Stastney joined from EDM on Oct 7 and has played beside Kris Letang.

UTA.head: Advantage, the Mammoth
UTA.body: Even though Utah will be without Carcone, the Mammoth have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage. The Penguins’ way back in is getting good looks.

PIT.head: The Penguins face a real test
PIT.body: Even though Utah will be without Carcone, the Mammoth have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage. The Penguins can pull it off if they get good looks.

story.head: Forecheck against patience
paras: The Mammoth are 6-3-0. The Penguins are on a three-game losing streak.
At home, André Tourigny likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Penguins’ first line. The Mammoth hound the puck, but the Pens sit back.

items.text: The Penguins are newly without Egor Chinakhov, and have been without Trevor van Riemsdyk since Oct 9.
Dylan Guenther has scored in three straight games against Pittsburgh.
Rickard Rakell is still looking for his first goal of the season.
NHL.com expects the Mammoth to dress the same lineup as last game.
